sources.title: Where in the String Landscape is Quintessence

evidence.text: Rotate kinetic terms into canonical form, construct the axion mass-squared matrix from the mixing matrix, and estimate its smallest eigenvalue from the leading characteristic cubic in the small-size-ratio, large-flux limit.

sources.title: Axions as Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Estimate backreaction through the fractional change of a warp-weighted internal volume. Separate induced antibrane sources into opposite-charge D3 sources and charge-neutral brane/antibrane pairs, using asymptotic throat perturbations and a cut-off AdS5×S5 model for parametric estimates.

sources.title: Dark energy from the string axiverse

evidence.text: Use the homogeneous axion equation with Hubble friction and the Friedmann equation, distinguishing frozen fields, coherent oscillations and hilltop evolution. The adopted acceleration eligibility criterion is the potential slow-roll condition ε=(MP²/2)(V′/V)²<1.

sources.title: Towards Early Dark Energy in string theory

evidence.text: For KKLT, use W = W0 + MS + Ae^(-aT) + Be^(-bG) + Ce^(-cG) + De^(-dG), with c = 2b and d = 3b. Split the scalar potential into KKLT and EDE pieces, suppress EDE cross-terms, and exhibit stabilization through potential profiles.

sources.title: String or M theory axion as a quintessence

evidence.text: Use holomorphy and discrete PQ periodicity to constrain gauge kinetic functions and holomorphic couplings. Estimate axion-dependent Kähler corrections by deformation from an N=2 setting, and identify the exponential factors with stretched membrane or wrapped D1/D5 instanton actions.

sources.title: Where in the String Landscape is Quintessence

evidence.text: Apply membrane-charge quantization to internal fluxes and constrain flux magnitudes by requiring their energy density to remain below the effective supergravity cutoff. These restrictions limit how small the light eigenvalue can become.

sources.title: The stochastic axiverse

evidence.text: The local setting isolates the instability of an axion placed close to the maximum of a periodic potential. Negative potential curvature competes with Hubble damping and determines how rapidly the field leaves its initial position.

sources.title: Axion inflation in type II string theory

evidence.text: Translate the prepotential into N = 1 Kähler coordinates and derivatives, combine flux and instanton superpotentials, and numerically minimize an approximate F-term potential. The example reduces the dynamics to R,v,b,c with degeneracy factors and uses leading metric expressions.

sources.title: Dante's Inferno

evidence.text: Estimate instanton amplitudes through Λ⁴ proportional to e^(−SED1), and assess decay-constant hierarchies using cycle geometry and warping. Compare induced D3 charge and NS5 worldvolume KK masses parametrically with the single-axion monodromy construction.

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Gaugino condensation produces W_np=A exp(−2πf_D7/N). Magnetization changes the holomorphic gauge kinetic function through odd moduli and fluxes; multiple wrapping changes its coefficients of Kähler moduli. These ingredients are inserted into the N=1 F-term potential.

sources.title: Large Field Ranges from Aligned and Misaligned Winding

evidence.text: Isolate a common parameter, compare its lower and upper scales, and then impose background relations. In this paper the procedure eliminates |W_0| and exposes the competition between an inflationary mass target, a Kaluza–Klein cutoff and exponential volume growth.

sources.title: Power spectrum of density perturbations in chain inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the finite first Born term along the classical bounce and use exp[−A_fin^(1)/2] with m^4S_E^2/(4π^2). This imported approximation does not make the quantum rate exact.

sources.title: Aligned natural inflation in the Large Volume Scenario

evidence.text: Canonical normalization of the Kähler metric, a matrix-valued decay constant, and rotations into heavy/light axion directions separate kinetic parameters from instanton charges. Integrating out the heavy axion illustrates the effective potential; the authors state that their cosmological analysis retains both axion dynamics.

sources.title: Large Field Ranges from Aligned and Misaligned Winding

evidence.text: Can flux stabilization lengthen a complex-structure axion without forcing saxion hierarchies that shrink its metric? The starting geometry suppresses exponentials for selected axions while retaining a positive mirror-volume cubic.

sources.title: On the Possibility of Large Axion Moduli Spaces

evidence.text: Can multiple axions yield a parametrically large inflationary field range without monodromy in a controlled string compactification, particularly through diagonal motion or kinetic alignment?

sources.title: Large Field Ranges from Aligned and Misaligned Winding

evidence.text: Can a periodic axion traverse a super-Planckian winding trajectory while spectator moduli remain stabilized and tower masses stay approximately fixed? The enhancement varies integer flux data across models; motion along each trajectory holds those data fixed.

sources.title: Constraints on Axion Inflation from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion decay-constant alignment yield a controlled super-Planckian inflationary displacement in type-IIB Calabi–Yau compactifications, and what restrictions follow from divisor geometry and the generalized multi-axion weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

evidence.text: How does entanglement determine Einstein–Rosen bridges and black-hole interiors, and does entanglement with a distant system require a firewall? The paper tests AMPS/AMPSS reasoning in two-sided black-hole models and proposes extensions to evaporating holes.

sources.title: Unitary S Matrices With Long-Range Correlations and the Quantum Black Hole

evidence.text: Can long-range correlations between incoming and outgoing black-hole states be incorporated into a unitary S matrix at intermediate evaporation stages, and what changes to causality and complementarity would this require?

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: How can black-hole evaporation preserve quantum information while allowing a smooth experience for an infalling observer, and how do quantum information theory and holography sharpen this problem?

sources.title: Spacetime has a “thickness”

evidence.text: If black-hole information returns in Hawking radiation and leading-order causality holds in gently curved spacetime, what can make an energetic infalling shell depart from semiclassical evolution before its information becomes trapped?

sources.title: Information in black hole radiation

evidence.text: Can perturbative calculations exclude gradual information recovery in black-hole radiation if unitary evaporation encodes information in exponentially small corrections or widely distributed correlations?

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on black holes

evidence.text: How can black-hole formation and evaporation be reconciled with quantum superposition, energy conservation and unitarity? The lectures use two-dimensional models to examine semiclassical evaporation and constrain possible descriptions beyond its endpoint.

sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole

evidence.text: Can bulk quantum entropy significantly displace quantum extremal surfaces during black-hole evaporation, and can the resulting entanglement wedge reproduce the Page curve and Hayden-Preskill information-recovery delay?

sources.title: The Page curve of Hawking radiation from semiclassical geometry

evidence.text: Can semiclassical geometry directly produce the Page curve of Hawking radiation, without merely inferring it from purity of the combined black hole–radiation state, and what entropy prescription accounts for interior islands?

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

evidence.text: Can the gravitational replica path integral directly yield a radiation entropy compatible with unitarity and the island rule, without higher-dimensional holographic input?

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: How can gravitational fine-grained entropy methods compute Hawking-radiation entropy consistently with unitary evaporation, despite the growing entropy obtained from the semiclassical radiation state?

sources.title: Hints of gravitational ergodicity: Berry’s ensemble and the universality of the semi-classical Page curve

evidence.text: Can an ensemble-averaged semiclassical calculation recover a unitarity-compatible Page curve within a single unitary theory, with the ensemble representing epoch time averages rather than distinct microscopic theories?

sources.title: Page curve and symmetries

evidence.text: How do conserved charges and explicit charge violation modify Page curves and symmetry-resolved entropies in a random qubit evaporation model, and what conditional lessons might this provide about black-hole evaporation and symmetries?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

evidence.text: Uses boundary time evolution to represent an early simple left operator A′ by a later scrambled operator A″ = exp(−2iHLt)A′exp(2iHLt). Bulk evolution relates A′ to an interior mode A; that relation depends on the bridge and on possible right-side disturbances.

sources.title: Unitary S Matrices With Long-Range Correlations and the Quantum Black Hole

evidence.text: Promote the interaction strength to a spacetime-dependent spurion g(x), split it into region-supported g1 and g2, and use functional Bogoliubov causality. Represent the boundary unitary by the Magnus form ω = exp(iφ), with Hermitian φ, allowing noncommuting operators.

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: Uses Euclidean path integrals for vacuum states and gravitational thermodynamics, including integration over metrics and different topologies. Comparing thermal-AdS and AdS-Schwarzschild saddle actions gives the Hawking-Page exchange of dominance.

sources.title: Spacetime has a “thickness”

evidence.text: A finite-depth lake and a one-dimensional potential well illustrate energy-dependent failure of semiclassical propagation and barrier lowering in superspace. These are schematic analogies rather than an explicitly solved collapse model.

sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole

evidence.text: Conformal and Weyl transformations map the matter state to a half-plane vacuum. Replica twist-operator correlators and a formal n→1 limit give interval entropies; conformal anomalies determine stress-tensor expectation values.

sources.title: What does the information paradox say about the universe?

evidence.text: What constraints does the adopted fuzzball resolution of the black-hole information paradox place on cosmology, and could virtual compression-resistant fuzzballs explain a small effective cosmological constant?

sources.title: The Scattering matrix approach for the quantum black hole: An Overview

evidence.text: Can black-hole formation and evaporation admit a unitary scattering matrix with finite entropy and a discrete spectrum, and what horizon degrees of freedom would implement it?

sources.title: Asymptotic Algebras and Holography of Information in CGHS Model

evidence.text: Does a specified gravitational completion of CGHS radiation encode its global state near past null-boundary endpoints, and can right-radiation island reconstruction coexist with exact left/right radiative commutativity?

sources.title: Islands far outside the horizon

evidence.text: Can islands associated with high-angular-momentum Hawking modes extend parametrically beyond the stretched horizon, and can asymptotic observers probe the resulting conflict with semiclassical locality?

sources.title: Virtual black holes

evidence.text: Can simply connected spacetime foam be interpreted as virtual black-hole loops, and does particle scattering from these fluctuations produce a nonfactorizing superscattering operator, observable coherence loss, or an endpoint for black-hole evaporation?

sources.title: Black Hole as a Quantum Field Configuration

evidence.text: Can semiclassical gravity and quantum matter provide a self-consistent evaporating black-hole interior, explain its supporting pressure and energy loss, and reproduce the entropy area law by counting field configurations?

sources.title: The VECRO hypothesis

evidence.text: Can extended, compression-resistant virtual configurations in the quantum-gravity vacuum resolve black-hole information loss, unbounded interior entropy, and the difference between black-hole and cosmological horizons while retaining leading-order causality?

sources.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction and the Information Paradox

evidence.text: Can quantum extremal surfaces and entanglement wedge reconstruction explain the Page curve, information recovery and a smooth evaporating horizon while retaining semiclassical Hawking entanglement? How does recovery depend on knowledge of the initial state?

destinations.title: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

How does entanglement determine Einstein–Rosen bridges and black-hole interiors, and does entanglement with a distant system require a firewall? The paper tests AMPS/AMPSS reasoning in two-sided black-hole models and proposes extensions to evaporating holes.

Can long-range correlations between incoming and outgoing black-hole states be incorporated into a unitary S matrix at intermediate evaporation stages, and what changes to causality and complementarity would this require?
How can black-hole evaporation preserve quantum information while allowing a smooth experience for an infalling observer, and how do quantum information theory and holography sharpen this problem?

If black-hole information returns in Hawking radiation and leading-order causality holds in gently curved spacetime, what can make an energetic infalling shell depart from semiclassical evolution before its information becomes trapped?

How can black-hole formation and evaporation be reconciled with quantum superposition, energy conservation and unitarity? The lectures use two-dimensional models to examine semiclassical evaporation and constrain possible descriptions beyond its endpoint.
